mapper.select: SELECT area_code,area_name,parent_code,area_level FROM ref_area WHERE status=#{status} AND COALESCE(parent_code,'')=#{parentCode} ORDER BY area_name
SELECT MAX(synced_at) FROM ref_area WHERE status=#{status} AND COALESCE(parent_code,'')=#{parentCode}
SELECT area_code,area_name,parent_code,area_level FROM ref_area WHERE status=#{status} AND area_code=#{areaCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ref_area WHERE status=#{status} AND area_code=#{areaCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE ref_area SET status='INACTIVE' WHERE status=#{status} AND COALESCE(parent_code,'')=#{parentCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ref_area (area_code,area_name,parent_code,area_level,status,synced_at) VALUES (#{areaCode},#{areaName},#{parentCode},#{level},#{status},#{syncedAt,typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE area_name=VALUES(area_name),parent_code=VALUES(parent_code),area_level=VALUES(area_level),status=VALUES(status),synced_at=VALUES(synced_at)
mapper.select: SELECT area_code FROM ref_area WHERE status=#{status} AND area_level IN (1,2) ORDER BY area_code
